actions.reason: config points to nonexistent data/shop_prod.db ("unable to open database file"); only data/shop.db exists.

root_causes.evidence: Path was data/shop_prod.db (nonexistent); the app logged 'unable to open database file' on /health, /stats, /orders and /products. Only data/shop.db exists.

report.summary: config.yaml pointed the database at the nonexistent data/shop_prod.db, so every DB-backed endpoint returned 500. The slow /products latency was a side effect: failures never populated the cache. I changed the path to data/shop.db and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests now pass, including a checkout whose order was persisted.
